messages:
lina: Quick sync 1: we need to finish SSO, KMS, and the listing bundle for cloudstore onboarding. Goal: staging ingest + legal signoff by EOD Fri. Assign owners? @mike infra, @sam legal, @anya packaging?

mike: I can take infra. Will provision S3 bucket, KMS key, and create the publisher role. Need the external ID value and confirmation on cross-account trust.

sam: Legal ok to review. Send full SKU slug, trial period, pricing tier, and whether trial includes access to Dedicated or just Hosted. Also confirm telemetry plan.

anya: I'll assemble the listing bundle: hero image, screenshots, quickstart, terraform snippet, and a short video. Do we have a manifest spec? If not I'll sketch one. Example manifest below:```json
{
  "product": "Redwood Inference",
  "sku": "rw-pro-1000",
  "version": "2026-03-1",
  "trial_days": 14,
  "trial_limits": "2k tokens/day",
  "assets": ["hero.png","quickstart.md","terraform.tf"],
  "regions": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"]
}```

lina: Use staging accounts: AWS 123456789012, GCP project redwood-marketplay-stg, Azure tenant 0a1b2c3d-xxxx. Branding and image pack at https://drive.redwood/partnerships/cloudstore-brand.

mike: KMS plan: generate key with admin principals limited to infra team, attach key policy that allows encryption for pub-ingest role only. Draft CLI:```bash
aws kms create-key --description "cloudstore/pubportal/staging" --policy file://kms-pub-policy.json
aws s3api create-bucket --bucket rw-cloudstore-staging --region us-west-2 --acl private
```

mike: I'll also create an IAM role 'pubportal-ingest' with PutObject restricted to a prefix and require MFA for console access. Lina pls confirm external ID string.

sam: On telemetry: default should be aggregated metrics only. If we need request traces, mark as opt-in and add DPA clause. For EU listings we should enable region-lock for data residency.

security: Confirmed: telemetry must be pseudonymized. Any opt-in detailed telemetry needs documented retention and a KMS key per region. Also require rotation cadence in the runbook.

anya: I'll make the quickstart and terraform example show how to set up the role and upload assets. Will include an onboarding checkbox for telemetry opt-in and link to the DPA.

lina: Owners and ETAs: mike -> infra + KMS policy (ETA: Fri AM). sam -> legal edits + trial terms (ETA: Thu EOD). anya -> package + terraform sample + video (ETA: Thu). I'll update tracker: https://docs.redwood/partnerships/cloudstore-onboard (adding owners).

mike: Added kms-pub-policy draft to infra folder. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll attach proposed EULA changes here once compiled.

deploy-bot: Build kicked: listing-bundle #4512 status: queued.

lina: Thanks all. Plan: legal signoff Thu, infra ready Fri AM, and candidate listing pushed to publisher staging Mon. Flag blockers here. :rocket:
